# Brackenwater renewal: customer redline

**Record Type:** Renewal Order Form and Operational Addendum (Customer Markup — For Review Only; Unsigned)  
**Record Date:** 2025-10-28  
**Routing Note:** Received from Brackenwater Freight Co. outside counsel on the morning of October 28, 2025, with redline insertions to Section 3 and Section 5. Logged to the Deal Desk repository for finance sign-off by Anselm Grieve and operational review prior to signature circulation.

---

### 1. Parties and Governing Agreement

**1.1 Identification of Parties.** This Renewal Order Form and Operational Addendum ("Renewal Addendum") is entered into by and between **Pemberline Systems**, a Delaware corporation having its principal place of business at 410 Mercer Wharf, Suite 800 ("Provider"), and **Brackenwater Freight Co.** ("Customer" or "BWF"), a Michigan corporation operating less-than-truckload freight terminals across the Great Lakes region, with administrative offices at 1900 Lakefront Industrial Parkway, Toledo, Ohio. Provider and Customer may each be referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."

**1.2 Reference to Master Agreement.** This Renewal Addendum supplements and modifies that certain Master Subscription Services Agreement between the Parties, together with all prior schedules and attachments thereto (collectively, the "Agreement"), governing Customer's access to and use of the **Pemberline Dock** yard and dock scheduling software platform (the "Hosted Service"). Except as expressly amended by the numbered provisions set forth herein, the terms and conditions of the Agreement shall remain in full force and effect. In the event of an irreconcilable conflict between the body of the Agreement and this Renewal Addendum, the provisions of this Renewal Addendum shall prevail solely with respect to the renewal period governed hereby.

---

### 2. Commercial Renewal Schedule

**2.1 Subscribed Seat Allocation.** Subject to Customer's timely remittance of applicable fees, Provider grants to Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to provision and maintain **75 subscribed seats** for the Hosted Service during the applicable renewal term. Subscribed seats are priced and allocated on a per-seat, per-year basis in accordance with Provider's standard licensing metrics.

**2.2 Named User Reassignment.** Each subscribed seat shall be assigned to an individual, named terminal clerk, yard spotter, dispatcher, or gate attendant employed or contracted by Brackenwater Freight Co. Customer may reassign a seat from a departing or transferred employee to a replacement employee without additional charge during shift rotations, provided that the aggregate number of active concurrent credentials provisioned across all BWF facilities does not exceed seventy-five (75) at any given time.

**2.3 Promotional and Commercial Discount.** In consideration of Customer's multi-terminal deployment and volume commitment hereunder, a commercial discount of **15%** shall be applied to Provider's prevailing per-seat annual list price for the 75 subscribed seats specified in Section 2.1. Pursuant to Provider's internal corporate governance policies, any discount exceeding ten percent (10%) requires the written authorization of Provider's Chief Financial Officer, Anselm Grieve, prior to final execution of this instrument by Provider.

---

### 3. Terminal Operations and Configuration Provisions (Customer Redline Insertions)

**3.1 Cross-Dock Gate Check-In Hardware.** *(Customer Counsel Insertion, 2025-10-28):* Provider acknowledges that Customer's third-shift freight handlers at the Toledo Central Hub (specifically Dock Doors 14 through 38) and the Grand Rapids West satellite yard utilize ruggedized handheld barcode scanners mounted to yard hostler cabs. Provider shall ensure that the Pemberline Dock mobile web view retains backward compatibility with Customer's existing Zebra TC77 handheld fleet without requiring firmware upgrades during peak mid-week LTL consolidation windows (Tuesday 22:00 Eastern through Friday 06:00 Eastern).

**3.2 Automated Detention Log Exports.** *(Customer Counsel Insertion, Oct 28):* Following the carrier dispute incident logged under Support Ticket #PD-88412 on October 14, 2025, regarding trailer dwell timestamps at the Milwaukee South Annex (Gate B), Provider agrees that the daily *Carrier Dwell & Yard Velocity CSV Report* shall automatically generate and deposit into Customer's designated SFTP directory no later than 04:30 Central Time each business day. Such report shall capture tractor arrival scan, gate pass issuance, dock door bump timestamp, and seal verification sign-off for each LTL linehaul trailer.

**3.3 Temporary Yard Overflow Rules.** In the event that winter weather advisories in the Great Lakes corridor require Customer to stage inbound pup trailers along the perimeter gravel lot at the Kalamazoo terminal, Customer's yard supervisors may generate unlimited virtual drop-spots within the Pemberline Dock yard map interface. Virtual drop-spots do not consume additional subscribed seats, provided that no additional user logins are created beyond the 75 seats authorized in Section 2.1.

---

### 4. Invoicing and Administrative Handling

**4.1 Billing Platform.** All invoices generated pursuant to this Renewal Addendum shall be issued through Provider's designated billing vendor, **Stoneharrow Billing**, and transmitted electronically to Customer's Accounts Payable department at `ap-freight@brackenwater.invalid`. Any technical inquiries regarding electronic data interchange (EDI 210/810) formatting or remittance portal credentials may be directed through Provider's deal desk to Felix Duarte at Stoneharrow Billing.

**4.2 Execution Mechanics.** This Renewal Addendum shall not bind either Party unless and until executed by authorized signatories of both Parties below. Delivery of this customer redline on 2025-10-28 for internal legal and finance review does not constitute an offer capable of acceptance by performance, nor does it extend any interim pricing concessions absent full countersignature.

---

### 5. Execution Block (UNSIGNED — FOR REVIEW ONLY)

*IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have caused this Renewal Addendum to be reviewed as of the date first written above. [Status as of 2025-10-28: Pending Deal Desk reconciliation of Section 3.1 hardware language and CFO discount sign-off; no signatures affixed.]*

# North weekly 4/28

Happy Monday team! Hope everyone stayed dry over the weekend—it poured nonstop here from Friday evening right through Sunday afternoon, and my dog is currently refusing to step on the wet grass in the backyard, which made getting to my desk on time a fun little adventure. Anyway, grabbing my second coffee and dropping our quick rundown for the week of 28 Apr 2025 before we jump into the afternoon standup.

| Customer | Status | Operational Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tamsin Cold Chain | Green | Kickoff completed 22 Apr 2025. Building out reefer door profiles for Tacoma. |
| Quarrendon Freight Lines | Green | MSA signed and live since 1 Apr 2025. Sorting out Gate 4 tablet issue. |
| Brackenwater Freight Co. | Yellow | Waiting on Dock 12-18 door schedule CSV from their Toledo yard lead. |
| Orrin Mills | Green | Quiet week, just tweaking the Detention Summary Report export columns. |

### Account Notes & Follow-ups

**Tamsin Cold Chain:** Huge shoutout on the kickoff call on 22 Apr 2025—it went really well! For the Northwest one Dana inherited, the cold storage supervisors were actually super prepared and brought a full spreadsheet of their carrier arrival windows and pre-cool buffer rules to the first session. Usually we have to chase people for two weeks just to get their shift handover times, so having their Tacoma night-shift lead walk us through how they stage refrigerated trailers on Doors 1 through 9 was a dream. We are setting up the temperature check prompts in Pemberline Dock this week and will do a quick sandbox walkthrough with their dispatchers on 1 May 2025.

**Quarrendon Freight Lines:** Just to make sure it is officially logged on the wiki page, the Quarrendon Freight Lines MSA is signed and live since 1 Apr 2025. On Marcus's freight account, Thea Ramaswell sent over a note on Friday afternoon about the ruggedized tablets at their St. Paul terminal—specifically at Gate 4, where the overnight yard jockeys are getting logged out of Pemberline Dock every time the Wi-Fi switches between the main warehouse access point and the guard shack repeater. We logged ticket #PD-8841 with support to check session persistence settings so drivers are not idling at the barrier waiting for a fresh login code during the 04:00 shift change.

**Brackenwater Freight Co. & Orrin Mills:** Pretty quiet on both fronts. Brackenwater still owes us the updated door mapping for Toledo after they repainted the west apron lanes, and Orrin Mills just asked if we could move the carrier SCAC column to the far left on their weekly Detention Summary Report.

### Team Housekeeping

One last thing before I forget! Please remember that open enrollment for company benefits closes on 2 May 2025. Do not leave it until Friday afternoon when HR is already offline. Make sure you can actually log into the portal today—Dana's benefits account got locked out this morning after two bad security question guesses and she is currently waiting on People Ops to push a password reset link. Go check your dental elections now!

# Renewal Order Form: Brackenwater Freight Co. (2025-2026 term)

## 1. Parties and Record Dates

This Renewal Order Form is entered into by Pemberline Systems (“Pemberline”) and Brackenwater Freight Co. (“Customer”) for the renewal of Customer’s subscription to Pemberline Dock, Pemberline’s yard and dock scheduling software.

This Order Form was drafted on 2025-11-10 and executed by both parties on 2025-11-21. Its effective date is 2025-12-01. The execution date records the parties’ signatures; it does not replace or advance the effective date.

## 2. Purpose and Relationship to Earlier Agreement

This Order Form changes the earlier agreement between Pemberline and Customer solely with respect to the subscription quantities, pricing, discount, and term dates expressly stated below. It records the commercial terms applicable to the 2025-2026 renewal term.

References in this Order Form to the earlier agreement mean the existing agreement governing Customer’s subscription to Pemberline Dock. Except as expressly changed by this Order Form, that agreement remains unchanged. This Order Form is to be read together with the earlier agreement, rather than as a replacement for the complete contractual relationship between the parties.

## 3. Subscription and Seat Quantity

The subscribed product is Pemberline Dock. The subscribed seat quantity for the renewal term is **64 seats**.

The quantity stated in this section is the quantity established by this Order Form. Administrative records used to arrange access, maintain user lists, or coordinate renewal processing shall reflect that quantity. Operational correspondence concerning individual users does not itself amend the subscribed seat quantity stated here.

Customer’s use of the subscribed product remains governed by the earlier agreement, except to the extent expressly modified in this Order Form.

## 4. Annual Seat Price and Discount

The price per seat per year is **USD 1,760**. The applicable discount is **8%**.

For the 64 subscribed seats, the annual amount before discount is USD 112,640. The 8% discount equals USD 9,011.20, resulting in a discounted annual subscription amount of **USD 103,628.80**.

These calculations express the seat quantity, annual seat price, and discount established by this Order Form. The discount does not alter the subscribed seat quantity. Any corresponding billing record shall identify the renewal subscription consistently with these figures and with the term dates stated below.

## 5. Renewal Term

The renewal term begins on **2025-12-01**. The end of the current term, identified for this Order Form as the renewal date, is **2026-11-30**.

The parties distinguish these subscription dates from the drafting and execution dates. Preparation on 2025-11-10 and signature on 2025-11-21 do not create an earlier subscription commencement date under this Order Form.

## 6. Effect of Changes

Where earlier paperwork for Customer states a different subscribed seat quantity, annual seat price, discount, or term date for this renewal, the corresponding provision of this Order Form controls.

No other change is made by this Order Form. Provisions of the earlier agreement concerning matters not expressly addressed here continue to apply. Renewal processing and related internal record updates shall be carried out on that basis.

## 7. Administrative Identification

The customer name for this renewal is Brackenwater Freight Co. References to this renewal in subscription administration and billing correspondence should identify both Customer and the 2025-2026 term so that the executed order is associated with the appropriate renewal record.

The signed version of this Order Form records the parties’ acceptance of the terms set out above.

## 8. Execution

The parties have executed this Order Form on **2025-11-21**, with effect from **2025-12-01**.

# Order Form: Brackenwater Freight Co. (2024-2025 term)

## 1. Parties and Record

This Order Form is between Pemberline Systems and Brackenwater Freight Co. for the subscription specified below. The subscribed product is Pemberline Dock, Pemberline Systems’ yard and dock scheduling software.

This instrument was drafted on 2024-11-01. The executed record was prepared on 2024-11-12 by June Osei-Lark, Deal desk and contracts manager, for inclusion in the order file. Brackenwater Freight Co. is identified in the associated setup materials by the abbreviations BWF and Bracken; those abbreviations refer to the same customer named in this instrument.

## 2. Execution and Effective Date

Both parties signed this Order Form on 2024-11-12. The effective date is 2024-12-01.

The execution date records the parties’ signatures. The effective date identifies the commencement of the subscription described herein. These dates are distinct; execution on 2024-11-12 does not replace or advance the stated effective date.

The signature block below forms part of this executed record.

## 3. Subscription and Commercial Schedule

The subscription is recorded as follows:

| Item | Order specification |
|---|---|
| Customer | Brackenwater Freight Co. |
| Supplier | Pemberline Systems |
| Product | Pemberline Dock |
| Subscribed seats | 60 |
| Price per seat per year | USD 1,700 |
| Discount | 8% |
| Effective date | 2024-12-01 |
| End of current term / renewal date | 2025-11-30 |

The annual per-seat price and the discount are stated separately. The discount applicable to this order is eight percent. The subscribed quantity is sixty seats.

The end of the current term, recorded as the renewal date, is 2025-11-30. That date is separate from both the drafting date and the execution date.

## 4. Operational Identification

Brackenwater Freight Co. operates in less-than-truckload freight in the Great Lakes region. The implementation worksheet accompanying the order file identifies the receiving desk, outbound dispatch desk, and evening yard desk as the initial points for collection of user details.

The worksheet includes a sample scheduling sequence for Door 14: an inbound trailer arrival, a receiving appointment, and an outbound door reassignment. It also includes a second-shift example in which dispatch moves a delayed pickup from the active door list to the next available appointment slot.

These entries describe the operational examples collected for setup review. They do not alter the subscribed seat quantity, annual per-seat price, discount, effective date, or term-end date stated in Section 3.

## 5. Administrative Handling

The order file includes this executed instrument and the setup worksheet titled “BWF Door Schedule — Initial Review.” The worksheet contains a column for shift designation and a separate column for the email address used at sign-in.

The receiving desk is collecting spelling corrections for the user list. Outbound dispatch is reviewing the Door 14 example against its paper appointment board. The evening yard desk is marking entries that represent shared desk labels rather than individual users. These administrative tasks concern setup preparation only.

# North weekly 28 Sept 2026

Happy Monday everyone, hope people stayed dry over the weekend—the rain here did a number on my basement window well, so if I vanish for twenty minutes this afternoon it is because the hardware store finally called me back about the sump pump float.

Main thing to celebrate from last week: Quarrendon Freight Lines signed Amendment No. 3 on Sept 22, which puts them at 230 seats starting January 1. June Osei-Lark already got the countersigned PDF filed away on Wednesday morning, and Thea Ramaswell sent over a very nice note about how the second shift at their Eau Claire yard finally stopped keeping the backup paper clipboards by Door 14. It is always a massive relief to get the ink dry on Dana's biggest account before the October rush starts eating everyone's calendar. Dana is still chasing down one weird bug for them (ticket #PD-8841, the gate kiosk printer at their Duluth terminal cuts off the last two digits of the trailer number when a driver checks in with a 53-foot dry van), so if anyone in support sees that ticket floating around, please give it a nudge.

Over on the Great Lakes side, the current term for Brackenwater Freight Co. ends Nov 30. We are getting into the window where we need their winter dock schedule locked down before lake-effect snow starts messing up their cross-dock turns in Toledo. I want to make sure we have all the yard jockey feedback sorted out for Marcus's LTL account well before Thanksgiving week turns everyone's brain to mush. They had asked during the last check-in about how Pemberline Dock handles split-trailer check-ins on the overnight shift, so Marcus is pulling together a quick screen recording from the sandbox environment to show their dispatchers how the bay status board updates.

In other news, Tamsin Cold Chain had a minor panic on Thursday afternoon when a reefer carrier showed up three hours early at their Tacoma facility and the guard shack tablet froze on the temperature log screen, though it turned out their own Wi-Fi repeater by the south fence had just been unplugged by a maintenance crew. And Thornbury Cloth Co. is still asking if we can rename the old "Orrin_South_Gate" export report in their automated Monday morning email—apparently it is still annoying their new plant controller every single week.

Lastly, a quick admin note from finance: Marcus's expense account got locked on Friday morning because the receipt photo from his Avis rental at O'Hare was just a blurry picture of his knee, so he has to re-upload the actual PDF invoice before noon tomorrow or the system will kick back his whole September mileage report. Check your own drafts in the portal if you travelled this month!
